description: Use when the traveler wants to book flights they have chosen: the sellers offering that exact itinerary (airline direct and agencies), each with its price and a link that opens its checkout on the seller's site. Takes a complete itinerary_id: one-way from search_flights, round trip from search_return_flights. Not for an outbound alone (choose a return first) and not a price watch (track_flight).

itinerary_id.description: A complete itinerary_id from search_flights (one way) or search_return_flights (round trip).
itinerary_id.title: Itinerary Id

sellers.description: Items: seller, price_usd, airline_direct, separate_tickets, book_url
